## Prompt selection (zero-shot google/flan-t5-base, 128 dev reports, greedy decoding)

| Prompt | ROUGE-1 | ROUGE-Lsum | Exact copy of report | Empty output | ms/report |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| translate | 0.299 | 0.275 | 33% | 2% | 181 |
| rewrite | 0.239 | 0.211 | 3% | 0% | 116 |
| explain | 0.109 | 0.104 | 9% | 0% | 29 |
| question | 0.249 | 0.231 | 20% | 0% | 55 |
| (copy the report unchanged) | 0.341 | 0.317 | 100% | 0% | 0 |

Best zero-shot prompt here: 'translate' (ROUGE-Lsum 0.275); the fixed prompt used everywhere is 'translate' (config.PROMPT_TEMPLATE, ROUGE-Lsum 0.275). If another prompt is better by more than 0.02 with flan-t5-base, set PROMPT_TEMPLATE to it in config.py BEFORE training, so the zero-shot baseline is as strong as possible.
